svg.text: Tajik & Uzbek national cuisine · 254 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Đà Nẵng
2.5 m opening, 4 steps from the sidewalk
velvet swags, runner, clay jars, lanterns
girih paving, 2.5 m, host at the exit
open to the sky, half-ring bench
6 guests each, kurpacha on 3 sides, entered from the path
entered from the east (1.8 m), U-sofa, 10 guests
in front of the tapchans, seen from the entrance and booths
open to the sky; 4 tables facing the mangal
tandoor · mangal · kazan · pass to guests

Roof opening, open to the sky
· Base: as-built DWG (Long House, 10-07-2024) 1:1. Levels: sidewalk
· Roof: steel beams on the grid, 50 mm sandwich panel, 5% fall to
the street, gutter along the street; balcony soffit +3.850, wave
· Over the chinars, courts open to the sky (roof opening with a
perimeter gutter): south 4.0 × 4.6 m, north 2.7 × 3.2 m. Only
· Every loose table is a 700 × 800 module: pairs split into 2-tops
or push together into tables for 6–8 (rows are aligned).
· Doors: C–D south open; C–D north and D–E south closed
(banquette); D–E north and E–F by the lift open.
Top 700 × 800, h 750; joined with hidden clamps
Concept for client review · dimensions to verify on site
